title: ancient wood
description: wood to the old_alpha version rd-132211
body:
Discover the charm of the very first Minecraft era with Ancient Wood! This mod adds a brand-new type of tree, letting you explore, chop, and craft with its unique wood. Perfect for retro builds, nostalgic worlds, or anyone wanting to expand the variety of natural materials in the original game.

To install in Prism Launcher create rd-132211 instance, click on it and select Edit, go to the Version, click on "Replace Minecraft.jar" and select this file
